use_case_name: Publish Air and Surface Surveillance Tracks

claims.content: The C2 JU reports Air and Surface (Maritime) surveillance track data to other network participants using specific messages (J3.2, J3.3) to support situational awareness and common tracking.

goal.raw_text: The C2 JU reports Air and Surface (Maritime) surveillance track data to other network participants using specific messages (J3.2, J3.3) to support situational awareness and common tracking.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has initially achieved Active status, or has returned to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure.
The C2 JU has performed sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration.
For common tracking to function properly, the C2 JU performs correlation and decorrelation of their local track data with respect to the remote data which they are receiving.

If assuming Reporting Responsibility (R²) of an Interface Unit (IU), the C2 JU has correlated local sensor data and meets specific conditions such as not receiving a J2 PPLI message for 40 to 60 seconds, or receiving a J2 PPLI message with NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, or receiving a J7.0 Drop Track message, or the Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.

The C2 JU has completed necessary reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration for an air or surface track after achieving or returning to Active status, and the minimum wait time (if applicable) has elapsed.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU has completed necessary reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration for an air or surface track after achieving or returning to Active status, and the minimum wait time (if applicable) has elapsed.

claims.content: After initially achieving Active status or returning to Active status, the C2 JU must wait a minimum of 12 seconds before transmitting air and surface tracks.
The C2 JU must ensure sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed before transmitting air, surface, or land tracks.
For real-time tracks, the C2 JU shall report the position of the track extrapolated to the time of transmission.

If automatic decorrelation tests determine that a local track satisfies criteria for decorrelation (e.g., falling outside maximum correlation distance), the C2 JU assigns a new Track Number (TN) to the local track.
Upon assigning a new TN during decorrelation, the C2 JU reports the new TN in a J3.2 or J3.3 message.
The C2 JU transmits the appropriate surveillance track message (J3.2 for Air Track or J3.3 for Surface Track) containing the required data.
If operational necessity requires it, the system may override the minimum wait time or have no wait time at all before transmitting tracks.
The C2 JU may report non-real-time surveillance tracks, which are monitored by non-C² JUs for situational awareness.
When a JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished Reporting Responsibility (R²) to another JU, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is not transmitted.
When a track becomes an Active Interface Unit (IU) on the network with the same Track Number (TN), a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is not transmitted.
When a JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished Reporting Responsibility (R²) to another JU, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is not transmitted.
When a track becomes an Active Interface Unit (IU) on the network with the same Track Number (TN), a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is not transmitted.
The C2 JU has transmitted the Air or Surface surveillance track data using the appropriate message type (J3.2 for Air, J3.3 for Surface).
If automatic or manual decorrelation was executed, the local track has been assigned a new Track Number (TN) and this new TN is reported in the transmitted J3.2 or J3.3 message.
For real-time tracks, the reported position is extrapolated to the time of transmission; for nonreal-time tracks, the data is identified as such and includes time tags without extrapolation.
The reporting C2 JU holds Reporting Responsibility (R²) for the track, ensuring it has the best positional data available on the interface.
Dual designations have been minimized through proper correlation and decorrelation procedures, resulting in a single common track number shared between C² JUs where applicable.
